sentence_2_en: There is no such thing, at this stage of the world's history in America, as an independent press. You know it and I know it. I am paid weekly for keeping my honest opinions out of the paper I am connected with. If I allowed my honest opinions to appear in one issue of my papers, before twenty-four hours my occupation would be gone.
